description:
Configure the Drupal Commerce store to support international sales. You need to:

1. Import two new currencies: Euro (EUR) and British Pound Sterling (GBP) via Commerce > Configuration > Currencies.
2. Configure the 'Urban Electronics' store to accept these new currencies (in addition to USD).
3. Create a new product 'European Travel Adapter' (SKU: EU-TRAVEL-ADAPT) priced at 24.99 EUR.
4. Create a new product 'British Audio Cable' (SKU: UK-AUDIO-CBL) priced at 12.99 GBP.

Ensure both products are Published.
